statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances and optimize rate control management
